name: core-periods-and-presence
description: Budget's meters that start again at each period (hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, everyMs, in UTC), count a rolling window, and take the usage a provider reports (observe, observePermission), with setLimit refused for a meter whose limit an own field holds; and Presence's ttlByState, the deadline a beat and a transition arm by the row's state; with each one's define refusals (D104). An engine type refuses each.
